rationale: With only 3 minutes to close, any position opened now faces forced market liquidation, creating unacceptable slippage risk on a stock trading at 95.6% of its daily range after a large gap-up move. The last candle shows a bearish reversal from the session high ($14.31) back to $14.22, but there is insufficient time to capture a meaningful short move before forced close. The risk/reward of entering either direction in the final minutes does not justify the execution and liquidation risk.
